goal: Implement a pure clamp utility in an isolated synthetic repository

tasks.title: Implement and test clamp
tasks.prompt: Create src/clamp.js exporting clamp(value,min,max). Clamp finite numeric values to inclusive finite bounds; throw RangeError for nonfinite inputs or min > max. Existing test/clamp.test.mjs is the independent acceptance contract. No dependencies, network, filesystem side effects, publishing, or deployment. Do not edit acceptance tests.
